dialogue.bca.npc-example.hurt-1.line.1: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.npc-example.npc-chat.line.1: Hello, Trainer! Nice to meet you!
Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.patreons.dragoon217.npc-cha: Not many wander this far. If you came to test yourself, I’ll make it worth your time.
You look confident. Let’s test your mettle and see if it’s as strong as mine.
Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.patreons.kuyajaedan.npc-cha: Hoi its nice to meet a fellow Trainer, what made you want to start your adventure? was it Wealth, Fame, Power? regardless what got you started, I would like to see what you got in a battle sometime .
dialogue.bca.patreons.kuyajaedan.about.m: Oh curious to know more about me? I actually stream a variety of games from time to time on Twitch. if you are curious to check out my Twitch just search KuyaJaedan.
Oh? You're approaching me? Instead of running away you've come to challenge me. Well lets see this team you are so confident in.
dialogue.bca.receptionists.nurse.joy.int: Welcome to the Pokemon Center!, We will heal you and your Pokemon.
I would offer to heal your Pokémon, but I can't seem to find my healing machine...
I would offer to heal your Pokémon for you, but your Pokémon are completely healthy!
I'd like to heal your Pokémon but my machine is busy! Please come back later!
Would you like me to heal your Pokémon?
dialogue.bca.receptionists.silverpine.hu: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.receptionists.silverpine.np: Welcome to Silverpine Lodge, Trainer. I'm your host.
If you’re looking to rest, relax, or simply escape the cold forest air, you’ve come to the right place! Is there anything I can help you with?
dialogue.bca.receptionists.silverpine.fa: Silverpine’s been standing longer than most folk remember. Treat her well, and she’ll do the same for you. Rooms fill quickly during snowstorms, so settle in early. Some guests come for rest... others come to disappear for a while. We don’t judge.
Which of our facilities would you like to know about?
Which of our facilities would you like to know about?
dialogue.bca.receptionists.silverpine.re: Our restaurant serves warm meals throughout the day — you’ll find it just beyond the main hall.
dialogue.bca.receptionists.silverpine.ta: The tavern is open every evening. Fires are lit, drinks are strong, and stories tend to get taller as the night goes on.
dialogue.bca.receptionists.silverpine.sp: If you’re here to unwind, the spa and pool area are kept warm year-round. A rare luxury this far north.
dialogue.bca.receptionists.silverpine.li: The library is quiet and well-kept — perfect if you prefer your evenings peaceful and your company bound in leather and ink.
dialogue.bca.receptionists.silverpine.lo: The lounge is just ahead. Soft chairs, low light, and a good place to wait out a storm.
dialogue.bca.receptionists.wyrmsrest.hur: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.receptionists.wyrmsrest.npc: Welcome to Wyrm’s Rest, Trainer. I'm your host.
Not much for luxury, but we keep the fire burning and the doors locked tight.
dialogue.bca.receptionists.wyrmsrest.fac: This place was built to endure. Same as the people who pass through it. If you’re looking for peace and quiet, you won’t find it here, especially near the bar. We don’t ask questions, just don’t start problems you can’t finish.
Which of our facilities would you like to know about?
dialogue.bca.receptionists.wyrmsrest.res: If you’re hungry, head down to the basement. The restaurant serves hot meals, no matter the hour.
dialogue.bca.receptionists.wyrmsrest.tav: The tavern’s on the first floor — hard to miss. Follow the noise and the smell of spilled ale.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.broconutpie.hurt: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.darkwolverine.hu: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.darkwolverine.np: Hey! I'm Darkwolverine, you can find me on Twitch at darkwolverine9.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.dragoon217.hurt-: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.dragoon217.npc-c: You caught me between campaigns. Sit a moment—tell me your strategy before we test it.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.dragoon217.about: I'm your host, a strategist, DM, and a trainer who wins by collapsing options, not by luck.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.dragoon217.battl: You found me — now prove you deserve the encounter. C’mon, Metagross.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.fishingninja25.h: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.fishingninja25.n: Welcome to my base, Trainer. I'm your host — I'm the general manager and a good friend of the founder strikebyte.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.fishingninja25.c: I'm a full time maintenance tech when im not gaming out. Original staff member to the discord and server, you will find me live on twitch at jedeboth125 were I stream the BCA modpack and many other games. I met strike playing a game called monster hunter world and the rest was history. I've been playing Pokemon since generation 4 and have been playing Minecraft since high school. Before Cobblemon, I owned a Pixlemon server that i played on with my friends, so when Strike asked me to be part of his staff, i knew that I could not let him down. I started on the server as a moderator, but as the server and staff grew and more responsibilities emerged, my position evolved into the GM that I am now. If you ever see me on line feel free to say hello and if you have problems let me know and I'll help to the best I can!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.fishingninja25.b: Nothing lasts forever without maintenance. Battle is just stress testing. Let’s see how well your team holds up under pressure and witness who cracks first.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.indeanajowns.hur: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.indeanajowns.npc: Name’s Indeanajowns — relic hunter, trouble magnet, and part-time Pokémon wrangler.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.indeanajowns.abo: I love a big swing. Sometimes it lands, sometimes it’s dramatic—either way, it’s entertaining.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.indeanajowns.bat: Keep your eyes open and your wits sharp. My team doesn’t forgive mistakes.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.ironboundjam03.h: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.ironboundjam03.n: Have you seen Professor Thorne lately?
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.ironboundjam03.t: He said he was close to a breakthrough, but some discoveries should stay buried... The ground has been quieter than usual; he left in a hurry. I found his notes, but not the ending. There are things beneath this world we don’t fully understand, and he was never reckless—that’s what worries me. If you hear anything unusual, tell me. Some fossils aren’t extinct; they’re just waiting. He believed the past wasn’t finished with us...
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.ironboundjam03.b: Let's see if you're ready for what's to come.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.joltthewolf.hurt: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.joltthewolf.npc-: Hey! I'm Jolt. I am the developer of Cobblemon: Armory!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kaydenbreak.hurt: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kaydenbreak.npc-: Welcome, Trainer, to my frozen paradise! Nestled in this frozen, floating geode, this tower is still very incomplete, but it does feature some interesting redstone contraptions. Feel free to take a look around!
Ha! A battle? Excellent! I've been bored, let's shake the ice a little!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kaydenbreak.abou: I am KaydenBreak, GengarTheTrainer, or Nezmir, one of the main developers for Brocraft Cobblemon Additions.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kaydenbreak.reds: Ah so you want to talk redstone! What were you curious about?
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kaydenbreak.sort: So you're interesting in my sorting system are you? I use Tom's Simple Storage to collect items from the lobby and distribute them throughout the tower. Each chest is connected via a pipe system that uses filters to choose what can be added or not.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kaydenbreak.elev: So you're interested in my elevator are you? It's pretty simple overall, just a soul sand, lava block elevator that switches based on the press of a button. It is pretty compact, but does have 1 flaw. Due to the method used to send the redstone signal vertically, the further you go up, the more delayed the elevator is.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kaydenbreak.reds: Not interested in how to move items or people? What about auto processing resources or getting a ton of iron?
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kaydenbreak.proc: So you're interested in my auto processors are you? I have a variety around here, from auto smelting, to fossil revitalization. You will have to look around to see what's here, but all of them are fairly simple thanks to my sorting system!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kaydenbreak.iron: So you're interested in my iron farm are you? There's not much to talk about. The farm is a very basic, and very effective, iron farm. You have 3 villagers and 1 zombie. The villagers get scared from the zombie and summon a golem. The golem then dies in the lava and we collect iron.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kaydenbreak.reds: Not those either huh, well what about food? Everyone needs food! Want to know how to get infinite food, apricorns, and bone meal?
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kaydenbreak.bone: So you're interested in my bone meal farm are you? This farm starts with a cobblestone generator. This cobblestone is then pushed to fill up the farm. Once full, a dispenser triggers on a moss block, turning the cobblestone to moss. The new cobblestone generated break the new moss blocks and other plant life, then we use water to collect it all into a composter!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kaydenbreak.farm: So you're interested in my other plant farms are you? Located on the top floor, we have some simple plant farms already, like bamboo and melon farms, as well as an apricorn farm! Depending on the farm, we use either shears or pistons to harvest, and hoppers to collect. Depending  on the mods, there might be a better collection method though...
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kaydenbreak.berr: So you're interested in my unfinished designs are you? Be aware, this will not work for everyone, as you need a better collection system then Cobblemon or Minecraft provide. The collection system I found to make an auto berry farm work is sophisticated storage/backpacks. The berry farm functions extremely similarly to the apricorn farm, but instead of using hoppers to collect the berries, we use a chest/backpack with advanced magnet. This collection tool can be used to automate the collection process of a lot of other farms too if desired! Can you make an auto berry farm?
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kuyajaedan.hurt-: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kuyajaedan.npc-c: Hoi, its nice to meet a fellow Trainer! What made you want to start your adventure? Was it wealth, fame, power? Regardless what got you started, I would like to see what you got in a battle sometime.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kuyajaedan.treas: My treasure has all my collection of fine equipment, trinkets, and unique finds I have found adventuring. Well I don't mind your ambition to seek out my treasures, I cant just tell you where they are. Though I do recall losing them to the belly of a beast on my adventures, before ending up here.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kuyajaedan.poked: Oh curious to know how dedicated I have been on the world are we?. Though I didn't join until after the first server event, I have seen over 800 cobblemon and caught 707. I'd like to see you and top my records.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.kuyajaedan.battl: Oh? You're approaching me? Instead of running away you've come to challenge me. Well lets see this team you are so confident in.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.sakuyahimevt.hur: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.sakuyahimevt.npc: Hello, Trainer! I'm Sakuyahime — welcome to my pink corner!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.sakuyahimevt.pat: I have a wonderful partner who supports my streams, and sometimes I need to rest for health reasons — your patience means the world.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.sakuyahimevt.plu: If you enjoyed this encounter, come hang out live! We chat, hunt shinies, and celebrate gaming as a whole! Find me at www.twitch.tv/sakuyahimevt.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.sakuyahimevt.bat: I might need to take it slow sometimes, but when I fight, I give everything! Contractees, cheer us on!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.strikebyte.hurt-: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.strikebyte.npc-c: Welcome to the Wyrm’s Rest, trainer. I’m Strikebyte — the original creator of Brocraft Cobblemon Additions… and the one who built this place.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.strikebyte.wyrms: This tower started as my base. Over time, it became a tavern. An inn. A gathering place. I always believed every world needed somewhere trainers could rest and prepare for what comes next. If you’ve got a smaller flying partner, the landing platform up top is open. Even dragons need somewhere to land. What began as a simple build eventually became part of the mod itself.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.strikebyte.bca.l: The 'B' in BCA stands for Brocraft. I started Brocraft as an SMP for my brothers and me. After two seasons, it grew beyond just family — friends joined, and the world felt alive. Then I discovered Cobblemon. I knew I wanted it to shape our next season. My kids were getting old enough to join our SMPs, and I wanted to build something truly special for them. But when I started preparing that world, something was missing. The structure mods available at the time didn’t feel like they truly belonged in a Cobblemon world. So I decided to build my own. At first, it was only meant to be a simple village set — something that felt natural alongside Cobblemon. It didn’t stay simple. The vision grew.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.strikebyte.visio: Cobblemon gives us the tools — Pokémon, battles, the foundation. BCA exists to fill the world around that foundation. To create towns that feel lived in. Structures that feel intentional. And a sense of progression that makes your journey feel earned. Every build, every structure, every update is meant to give trainers a world that grows with them.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.strikebyte.battl: Every world starts with an idea. Every trainer writes their own story. Show me how yours is unfolding.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.teddycheese.hurt: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.teddycheese.npc-: Heh, welcome to my den. You look like you could use a warm-up. Lucky for you, I brought the heat.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.teddycheese.abou: I love a big swing. Sometimes it lands, sometimes it’s dramatic—either way, it’s entertaining.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.teddycheese.batt: You wanted a spectacle—let me give you a performance you’ll remember.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.terrablast98.hur: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.terrablast98.npc: Good to see another trainer who appreciates the outdoors! I fish, I adventure, and I train — glad you stopped by!
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.terrablast98.see: Some seeds only wake when the ice thins. I mark those spots with a white stone.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.terrablast98.hol: Beat me and I’ll tell you the coordinates of a secret fishing hole — but only if you earned it.
dialogue.bca.s1.npcs.s1.terrablast98.bat: Greenhorn, you’re out of your depth. Don’t drown in overconfidence.
Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
I'm pretty sure my sense of direction is powered by a potato.
dialogue.bca.staff.fishingninja25.hurt-1: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.staff.fishingninja25.npc-ch: Hmmm, I smell the stench of a trainer that thinks they can beat me and my ground types. if you think you have what it takes to beat me, show me you have what it takes to be here.
I’ve always admired Ground-types for their raw, unstoppable power. My team draws strength from the very earth itself. Torterra—let’s show this fool the true might of the planet!
dialogue.bca.staff.fishingninja25.about-: I am FishingNinja25, the Discord Moderator for the Brocraft Cobblemon Additions Official Server.
dialogue.bca.staff.ironboundjam03.hurt-1: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.staff.ironboundjam03.npc-ch: Ah… a challenger daring to test the Elite Four. Bold. I hope your resolve is as strong as your Pokémon.
I’ve trained alongside legends, battled the toughest, and faced the wildest storms. Can you withstand the fury of my team?
dialogue.bca.staff.ironboundjam03.about-: I am IronBoundJam03, one of the owners and main builders for Brocraft Cobblemon Additions.
dialogue.bca.staff.kaydenbreak.hurt-1.li: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
Ah, a challenger reaches my chamber… excellent.
Most trainers underestimate Bug‑types — until they’re wrapped, trapped, and devoured by strategy.
Let’s see if you can break free of my web.
dialogue.bca.staff.kaydenbreak.npc-chat2:
I’ve studied Bug Pokémon since I could walk.
Bugs evolve faster, adapt quicker, and strike harder than anyone realizes.
Show me if you can keep up… or if you’ll get caught in the swarm!
I am KaydenBreak, GengarTheTrainer, or Nezmir, one of the main developers for Brocraft Cobblemon Additions.
dialogue.bca.staff.rhett.architect.greet: Power is common. Preparation is rare.
Let's see how your team is engineered.
dialogue.bca.staff.rhett.architect.about: Every system fails somewhere. I find where yours does.
If you can't beat me, the rest of the Elite Four isn't for you.
dialogue.bca.staff.rhett.architect.decli: Smart. Recognizing when you're underprepared is the first step.
dialogue.bca.staff.strikebyte.hurt-1.lin: Do you think I'd talk to you after you attacked me!? Get out of here!
dialogue.bca.staff.strikebyte.npc-chat.l: Hello, Trainer! Nice to meet you!
